subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should maintainers ship a patched stable release for the v2026.6.11 npm package parity failure now, or leave affected stable users on v2026.6.11 until the next scheduled stable release?
rationale: The source fix is present on main, but deciding release timing, package validation, and user communication for the latest stable artifact requires maintainer release ownership.

options.title: Ship patched stable now
options.body: Publish a new stable package from fixed source and verify the tarball contains the reentrant store-writer/session-accessor pair before closing this issue.

options.title: Wait for scheduled stable
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical warning until the next stable release replaces npm latest and includes package parity proof.

recommendation.title: Ship patched stable now
recommendation.body: Publish a new stable package from fixed source and verify the tarball contains the reentrant store-writer/session-accessor pair before closing this issue.
